sections.heading: Signal House at a glance
sections.body: Signal House is an SMS and Voice API platform built as the best Twilio alternative, offering lower pricing, white-glove support, 24–48 hour A2P approvals, simpler APIs, and stronger deliverability.

sections.heading: Where it may fit in a shortlist
sections.body: Based on its positioning under Vertical Industry Software, Signal House is most relevant during early market discovery. The available record includes 7 category signals and 2 commercial records, giving buyers a starting point—not a substitute for requirements validation.

sections.heading: Questions to ask before buying
sections.body: Ask Signal House for a workflow-specific demonstration, itemized pricing, implementation responsibilities, data-processing terms, support response targets, and references from organizations with a similar scale and use case.

sections.heading: Our research perspective
